text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 and tail latency spike detected for dedicated-eu-pool-12 (> 2.1s). queue_depth for pool-12 > 800, threshold 300. streaming stalls observed. auto-escalation: paging SRE oncall. severity: SLO-impacting :rotating_light:

sre-oncall: taking. joining bridge now. I see the alert and graphs in ops (p95 ~ 450ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 2.3s).

alex_engruntime: yup hitting tailstorm. logs show a series of handshake timeouts from the autoscaler to pool-12 leader starting at +00:02:10. scale-up requests are queued.

maya_platform: autoscaler leader PID swapped during deploy 00:01:45. leader state is 'preparing' for a long time, not handing new slot requests. looks like the prepare path hit a mutex on the NFS mount.

jordan_prod: customer visible for some chat workloads — CS pinged. CS reports some customers seeing 'stalled' streaming chunks and inflated token latency.

lee_cs: confirmed — two customers in EU3 reporting degraded response times and some timeouts on long running streams. escalation email sent.

harper_o11y: timeline in honeycomb: spike aligns with a surge of hotshots (~120% of expected). prefix-cache hit rate dropped from 87% -> 10% for pool-12 (cold-kv path). KV cache misses magnify warmup.

sam_mlinfra: root suspicion: combination of warmup cold pools + autoscale leader not allocating new GPUs fast enough. model KV-loads take ~600ms first token on cold path. with burst > 2x, queue blows.

sre-oncall: can we open a live bridge? I'm starting one now.

incident-bot: Bridge created: https://bridge.internal/room/gh-1738801234 (auto). set severity to P1.

alex_engruntime: attempting manual pool resync. I'm going to set pool-12 -> reserved-capacity override +2 for 15m to buy time.

maya_platform: manual override requested. running command:
```
platformctl pools reserve --pool dedicated-eu-pool-12 --add 2 --ttl 900
```

alex_engruntime: command issued, response: accepted. new slots allocating, but nodes are stuck pulling container images (registry IO errors)

harper_o11y: registry IO errors correlate with sporadic eu-registry write latency. ops network team alerted.

lee_cs: leaving short templated customer update: "We're aware of higher latencies for EU chat; engineers are actively mitigating and routing failover is in progress. Will update in 15m." Want me to send?

jordan_prod: send it. include recommendation to retry, and note streaming can resume with shorter context to avoid cold-KV penalty.

sam_mlinfra: quick mitigation plan: 1) route a percent (20%) of EU traffic to quantized-compatible fallback model in eu-fallback-1 (lower mem). 2) increase KV cache prewarm on pool-13 and enable aggressive prefix caching. 3) tilt routing to non-EU region for tolerant customers.

alex_engruntime: enacted step 1: routing rule added (20% -> eu-fallback-1) via routing service. rule id r-17388. monitor for correctness.

harper_o11y: metrics: after routing change (t+6m) p99 for pool-12 decreased from 2.3s -> 1.6s, queue depth fell from 820 -> 460. good but still above SLO. streaming error rate down 35%.

maya_platform: registry issue resolved by infra team — image pull success rate back to normal. new nodes finished join. autoscaler leader still in 'recover' state; investigating handshake queue backlog.

alex_engruntime: warmup: need to preheat KV for hot customers. I'm triggering targeted preheat for top 25 customers on pool-12 with command:
```
infra-run preheat-kv --pool dedicated-eu-pool-12 --customers-file /tmp/top25.txt
```

lee_cs: scheduled a proactive customer update at T+15m. noted which accounts impacted and which we routed.

emily_pm: product note: we should disable large context default for EU for now until we have stable handshakes. will coordinate a config flip.

sam_mlinfra: follow-up: autoscaler backlog root cause: leader retry loop blocked on a delayed healthcheck to the orchestration DB (timeouts). adding circuit-breaker and better backoff in follow-up PR.

harper_o11y: timeline entry: 1738801234 root alert. mitigation steps: manual reserve +2, routing 20% to fallback, preheat top25 customers, registry fix, autoscaler leader recover. current state: degraded but stable, p99 ~ 1.1-1.6s.

sre-oncall: I'm going to keep the bridge up for at least 30m and follow up with post-incident notes. paging rotation: standby notified to join for handoff at T+25m.

lee_cs: customer update posted.

jordan_prod: recommend follow-ups: 1) postmortem to include autoscaler leader hardening, 2) prewarm policy for hotshot bursts, 3) routing playbook update for fallback model and context limits.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned id INC-2024-173880. Closing automated escalation.

sre-oncall: closing bridge in 30m unless we see regression. leaving notes here. :thumbsup:
